label: Finesse shot
desc: Curl the ball round the keeper. Opens a curling option on shots.

label: Chip
desc: Lift the ball over a keeper or defender with a delicate touch.

label: Trickster
desc: Skill moves to beat a defender. Opens flair options in one-on-ones.

label: Press resistant
desc: Stay calm and turn away when closed down. Helps you escape pressure.

label: Aerial threat
desc: Dominant in the air. Opens back-post options and helps in aerial duels.

label: Set-piece specialist
desc: Deadly from dead balls. Opens curling free kicks and helps deliveries.

label: Sweeper keeper
desc: Command the space behind the defence. Opens high sweeping options.

label: Reads the game
desc: See situations a step earlier. You read moments better and can intercept.

label: Hard tackler
desc: Win the ball with a crunching challenge. Opens sliding tackles.

label: Poacher
desc: Always in the right place. Opens sharper movement in the box.

label: Playmaker
desc: The pass others do not see. Opens inch-perfect passing options.

label: Shot stopper
desc: Sharp on the line. Helps in saves and opens a reaction option.
